acceptance.given: A skill package contains three primary examples whose order violates the required typical, boundary, error sequence.

oracle.expected: The skill-quality validator reports a wrong-order failure and rejects the package.
forbidden: A wrongly ordered primary set is accepted as valid.
oracle.observable: Validator diagnostics and exit status for the wrong-order primary-example check.

acceptance.then: The wrongly ordered primary set is rejected.
acceptance.when: Run the strict skill-quality validator against the package and inspect the wrong-order diagnostic.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the wrong-order primary-example test selector and observe the validator fail the malformed ordering.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add validation that rejects primary examples arranged outside the required typical, boundary, error order.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema migration; reverting the new validator and example helper restores prior behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A malformed primary-example ordering transitions from unvalidated input to an explicit validation failure.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The wrong-order pytest selector passes after the validator reports rejection for the malformed primary-example order.
